43821.commentary: (ANa) cīvaraṃ paribhuñjamāno'ti cīvar'atthāya vatthaṃ labhitvā sūcisutt'ādīnaṃ abhāvena taṃ nikkhipanto'pi karonto'pi pārupanto'pi jiṇṇakāle paccattharaṇaṃ karonto'pi paccattharitum'pi asakkuṇeyyaṃ bhūm'attharaṇaṃ karonto'pi bhūmattharaṇassa ananucchavikaṃ phāletvā pādapuñchanaṃ karonto'pi paribhuñjamāno'tveva vuccati. yadā pana pādapuñchanam'pi na sakkā idan'ti sammajjitvā chaḍḍitaṃ hoti, tadā paribhuñjamāno nāma na hoti.

examples.text: katame cattāro? yassa, bhikkhave, bhikkhu cīvaraṃ paribhuñjamāno appamāṇaṃ cetosamādhiṃ upasampajja viharati, appamāṇo tassa puññ'ābhisando kusal'ābhisando sukhass'āhāro sovaggiko sukhavipāko saggasaṃvattaniko iṭṭhāya kantāya manāpāya hitāya sukhāya saṃvattati.
rājā satthu vacanaṃ sutvā, aho, bhante, bhāriyaṃ kammaṃ, ettake nāma bhoge vijjamāne n'eva attanā paribhuñji, na tumhādise buddhe dhuravihāre viharante puññakammaṃ akāsī'ti āha.
tatiyam'pi kho, vāseṭṭha, so satto sakaṃ bhāgaṃ parirakkhanto aññataraṃ bhāgaṃ adinnaṃ ādiyitvā paribhuñji.

43826.meaning2: should be eaten, should be used, should be enjoyed

na jānaṃ uddissakataṃ maṃsaṃ paribhuñjitabbaṃ. yo paribhuñjeyya āpatti dukkaṭassa. anujānāmi tikoṭiparisuddhaṃ macchamaṃsaṃ, adiṭṭhaṃ assutaṃ aparisaṅkitan'ti.

nikkhanto kho te, bhante, upaṭṭhāko antokumbhiyā odanaṃ gahetvā pariyogā sūpaṃ gahetvā paribhuñjāti. atha khv'āhaṃ, mahārāja, kumbhiyā odanaṃ gahetvā pariyogā sūpaṃ gahetvā paribhuñjitvā uṭṭhāy'āsanā pakkamiṃ.
āsanasālāya nisinnakāle yāguṃ vā bhattaṃ vā gahetvā nisinnakāle paribhuñjitvā nisinnakāle divāvihāraṭṭhāna-gamanakāle'pi.

43831.grammar: prp of pass of pari √bhuj, pass, intrans

examples.text: tassa te bhoge evaṃ sammā paribhuñjiyamāne n'eva rājāno haranti, na corā haranti, na aggi ḍahati, na udakaṃ vahati, na appiyā dāy'ādā haranti. evaṃ'sa te, mahārāja, bhogā sammā paribhuñjiyamānā paribhogaṃ gacchanti, no parikkhayaṃ.
amataṃ tesaṃ, bhikkhave, aparibhuttaṃ yesaṃ kāyagatāsati aparibhuttā. amataṃ tesaṃ, bhikkhave, paribhuttaṃ yesaṃ kāyagatāsati paribhuttā'ti
taṃ, bhante, bhagavā paṭhamaṃ paribhuñjatu. bhagavatā paṭhamaṃ paribhuttaṃ pacchā kāpilavatthavā sakyā paribhuñjissanti. tadassa kāpilavatthavānaṃ sakyānaṃ dīgharattaṃ hitāya sukhāyā'ti.
atha kho āyasmā ānando catugguṇaṃ saṅghāṭiṃ paññapetvā bhagavantaṃ etadavoca, tena hi, bhante, bhagavā nisīdatu ettha. ayaṃ bhūmipadeso dvīhi arahantehi sammāsambuddhehi paribhutto bhavissatī'ti.
n'āhaṃ taṃ, cunda, passāmi sadevake loke samārake sabrahmake sassamaṇabrāhmaṇiyā pajāya sadevamanussāya, yassa taṃ paribhuttaṃ sammā pariṇāmaṃ gaccheyya aññatra tathāgatassā'ti.

43836.commentary: (DNa) mitt'āmaccānaṃ paribhūto hotī'ti tañ'hi mitāmaccā evaṃ vadanti, samma, tvam'pi nāma kulaputto jūtakaro chinnabhinnako hutvā vicarasi, na te idaṃ jātigottānaṃ anurūpaṃ, ito paṭṭhāya mā evaṃ kareyyāsī'ti. so evaṃ vutto'pi tesaṃ vacanaṃ na karoti. tato tena saddhiṃ ekato na tiṭṭhanti na nisīdanti. tassa kāraṇā sakkhipuṭṭhā'pi na kathenti. evaṃ mitt'āmaccānaṃ paribhūto hoti.

examples.text: jayaṃ veraṃ pasavati, jino vittam'anusocati, sandiṭṭhikā dhanajāni, sabhāgatassa vacanaṃ na rūhati, mitt'āmaccānaṃ paribhūto hoti, āvāhavivāhakānaṃ apatthito hoti, akkhadhutto ayaṃ purisapuggalo n'ālaṃ dārabharaṇāyā'ti.
nivatth'avatthen'eva gehato nikkhamitvā paramasallekhavuttiko'pi abalabalo amandamando viya paresaṃ acittakarūpena hīḷitaparibhūto hutvā gāmanigamarājadhānīsu ekarattivāsen'eva vicarati.

addasā kho bhagavā āyasmantaṃ lakuṇḍakabhaddiyaṃ dūrato'va āgacchantaṃ. disvāna bhikkhū āmantesi, passatha no tumhe, bhikkhave, etaṃ bhikkhuṃ āgacchantaṃ dubbaṇṇaṃ duddasikaṃ okoṭimakaṃ bhikkhūnaṃ paribhūtarūpan'ti? evaṃ, bhante.

ratanasammataṃ nāma yaṃ manussānaṃ upabhogaparibhogaṃ, etaṃ ratanasammataṃ nāma.
tīhi kho ahaṃ, jīvaka, ṭhānehi maṃsaṃ paribhogan'ti vadāmi. adiṭṭhaṃ, asutaṃ, aparisaṅkitaṃ, imehi kho ahaṃ, jīvaka, tīhi ṭhānehi maṃsaṃ paribhogan'ti vadāmi.

cattāro kho me, mahārāja, daharā'ti na uññātabbā, daharā'ti na paribhotabbā. katame cattāro?

43857.commentary: (ANa) kiṃ kathā nāma esā'ti vadanto kathaṃ paribhoti nāma.

examples.text: kathaṃ paribhoti, kathikaṃ paribhoti, attānaṃ paribhoti, vikkhittacitto dhammaṃ suṇāti, anek'aggacitto ayoniso ca manasi karoti. imehi kho, bhikkhave, pañcahi dhammehi samannāgato suṇantopi saddhammaṃ abhabbo niyāmaṃ okkamituṃ kusalesu dhammesu sammattaṃ.
ṭhitako kho pana so bhavaṃ gotamo anonamanto ubhohi pāṇitalehi jaṇṇukāni parimasati parimajjati, idam'pi tassa bhoto gotamassa mahāpurisassa mahāpurisalakkhaṇaṃ bhavati.

tassa mayhaṃ, sāriputta, na evaṃ hoti, aho vat'āhaṃ imaṃ rajojallaṃ pāṇinā parimajjeyyaṃ, aññe vā pana me imaṃ rajojallaṃ pāṇinā parimajjeyyun'ti. evam'pi me, sāriputta, na hoti. idaṃsu me, sāriputta, lūkhasmiṃ hoti.
kiṃ te jaṭāhi dummedha, kiṃ te ajinasāṭiyā, abbhantaraṃ te gahanaṃ, bāhiraṃ parimajjasī'ti.

tam'enaṃ aññataro saddho pasanno passati taṃ bhikkhuṃ anekavihitaṃ iddhividhaṃ paccanubhontaṃ… ime'pi candimasūriye evaṃ mah'iddhike evaṃ mah'ānubhāve pāṇinā parāmasantaṃ parimajjantaṃ yāva brahmalokā'pi kāyena vasaṃ vattentaṃ.

ye hi keci, bhikkhave, atītam'addhānaṃ samaṇā vā brāhmaṇā vā anekavihitaṃ iddhividhaṃ paccanubhosuṃ… ime'pi candimasūriye evaṃmah'iddhike evaṃmah'ānubhāve pāṇinā parimasiṃsu parimajjiṃsu, yāva brahmalokā'pi kāyena vasaṃ vattesuṃ, sabbe te catunnaṃ iddhipādānaṃ bhāvitattā bahulīkatattā.

so sādhū'ti sampaṭicchitvā attano nivāsaṭṭhāne nisīditvā tassa ekam'antaṃ parimajji, parimajjitaṭṭhānaṃ kāḷakam'ahosi. so evaṃ parisuddham'pi nāma vatthaṃ imaṃ attabhāvaṃ nissāya kāḷakaṃ jātan'ti saṃvegaṃ paṭilabhitvā vipassanaṃ ārabhi.

examples.text: so catassannaṃ parisānaṃ dhammaṃ deseti parimaṇḍalehi padabyañjanehi anuppabandhehi anusayasamugghātāya. evarūpena kho, āvuso sāriputta, bhikkhunā gosiṅgasālavanaṃ sobheyyā'ti.

43871.commentary: (ANa) parimaṇḍalehi padabyañjanehī'ti ettha padam'eva atthassa byañjanato padabyañjanaṃ. taṃ akkharapāripūriṃ katvā dasavidhaṃ byañjanabuddhiṃ aparihāpetvā vuttaṃ parimaṇḍalaṃ nāma hoti, evarūpehi padabyañjanehī'ti attho.

ayaṃ kho me kāyo rūpī cātumahābhūtiko mātāpettika-sambhavo odanakummāsa-upacayo anicc'ucchādana-parimaddana-bhedana-viddhaṃsana-dhammo, idañ'ca pana me viññāṇaṃ ettha sitaṃ ettha paṭibaddhan'ti

43881.commentary: (ANa) so ca n'esaṃ ucchādana-parimaddana-nhāpana-sambāhanenā'ti so ca putto n'esaṃ mātāpitūnaṃ aṃsakūṭesu ṭhitānaṃ'y'eva duggandha-paṭivinodan'atthaṃ sugandhakaraṇena ucchādanena, parissama-vinodan'atthaṃ hatthaparimaddanena, sīt'uṇhakāle ca uṇh'odaka-sīt'odaka-nhāpanena, hatthapād'ādīnaṃ ākaḍḍhanaparikaḍḍhanasaṅkhātena sambāhanena upaṭṭhānaṃ kareyya.

examples.text: ṭhitako kho pana so bhavaṃ gotamo anonamanto ubhohi pāṇitalehi jaṇṇukāni parimasati parimajjati, idam'pi tassa bhoto gotamassa mahāpurisassa mahāpurisalakkhaṇaṃ bhavati.
ime'pi candimasuriye evaṃmah'iddhike evaṃmah'ānubhāve pāṇinā parimaseyyaṃ parimajjeyyaṃ, yāva brahmalokā'pi kāyena vasaṃ vatteyyan'ti, tatra tatr'eva sakkhibhabbataṃ pāpuṇāti sati sati āyatane.

43892.meaning1: touched around; stroked around; rubbed around

examples.text: atha kho bhagavā jivhaṃ ninnāmetvā ubho'pi kaṇṇasotāni anumasi parimasi, ubho'pi nāsikāsotāni anumasi parimasi, kevalam'pi nalāṭamaṇḍalaṃ jivhāya chādesi.
api ca kho, mahārāja, pabbajito'va sāmaññassa issaro adhipati, pabbajjā, mahārāja, bahuguṇā anekaguṇā appamāṇaguṇā, na sakkā pabbajjāya guṇaṃ parimāṇaṃ kātuṃ.

43895.synonym: paricchinna, paritta, pariyantakata, parivaṭuma, mita, sammita

examples.text: katamehi catūhi? naṭṭhaṃ gavesanti, jiṇṇaṃ paṭisaṅkharonti, parimitapānabhojanā honti, sīlavantaṃ itthiṃ vā purisaṃ vā ādhipacce ṭhapenti. yāni kānici, bhikkhave, kulāni bhogesu mahattaṃ pattāni ciraṭṭhitikāni bhavanti, sabbāni tāni imehi catūhi ṭhānehi, etesaṃ vā aññatarenā'ti.

43897.grammar: ind, adv, acc sg of parimukha

examples.text: so pacchābhattaṃ piṇḍapātapaṭikkanto nisīdati pallaṅkaṃ ābhujitvā ujuṃ kāyaṃ paṇidhāya parimukhaṃ satiṃ upaṭṭhapetvā

43898.grammar: ind, adv, acc sg of parimukha
43898.meaning1: (comm) at the tip of the nose or on the upper lip
43898.commentary: (DNa) parimukhaṃ satiṃ upaṭṭhapetvā'ti… mukhasamīpe vā katvā'ti attho. ten'eva vibhaṅge vuttaṃ, ayaṃ sati upaṭṭhitā hoti sūpaṭṭhitā nāsik'agge vā mukhanimitte vā, tena vuccati parimukhaṃ satiṃ upaṭṭhapetvā'ti (vibha. 537).
